title: Battle of music with the Sunset Royal band in Cincinnati
summary: The Pillars band outplays Florida's Sunset Royal in a battle, its big tones overwhelming their comedy-routine show band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: You missed it, that's right. That was 1938. We played -- we left here and went to Cincinnati, Ohio. The band was hitting real good. The band was hitting, I mean,
the band was really swinging. And the people were crazy about the band in Cincinnati. And that was the time we played a battle of music (unintelligible) against the Sunset --
Sunset Royal. You ever hear of the Sunset Royal band?

From Florida, yes, uh-huh. We played a battle of music against them, they came in and they remarked, were marching, we all got a nice little band, blah blah this and blah blah that. They opened up -- I think we opened first.
They opened first. They started doing a playing horns behind their comedy routine, started going behind the backs.

Things like that, and they did that number, had a nice hand and everything, We went on and sound like a steamboat behind them. All those big tones and everything, opened their mouths and and the people (unintelligible) start watching. led
That's the best they could do, just open their mouths and start watching. And they would n't leave the dance floor.
